        candidate = c
        break

    candidate = candidates[0]

grasp(candidate)

# Find free spot in green_case

x, y = spot["x"], spot["y"]

# Carry to spot with correct yaw alignment: rotate to match case's long axis
delta_yaw = zone["long_axis_yaw"] - obj["long_axis_yaw"]
carry_to(x, y, height=0.18, yaw=None)
rotate_by(delta_yaw)

# Lower until contact and release
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()

# Final check
check("yellow_pen", "green_case")
